sources.claimScope: Huawei unveiled the Atlas 960E SuperPoD on September 17, called the Ascend 960 supernode in Chinese. It uses UnifiedBus, Hi-ONE NPO optical engines and full liquid cooling. Vendor-stated limits are 4,096 NPUs, 8 EFLOPS FP8 and 16 EFLOPS FP4—system specifications, not single-chip performance. Huawei targets Ascend 960DT readiness in Q1 2027 and 960PR in Q3. Its separate architecture announcement still describes the 960 system as under testing. The launch and roadmap do not establish volume deliveries.

ERCOT is requesting state and community-impact information from developers seeking interconnection for data centers of at least 25 MW. The September 18 questionnaire covers public assistance, power, water, cooling and community effects, with water questions coordinated with PUCT and TWDB. Responses are due October 12; a joint report with PUCT is planned by December 10. This information request is not an energization approval.

Dexus disclosed that the ADC, Zerra DC and Macquarie Capital consortium signed stage-one lease documentation with Anthropic’s Australian subsidiary, subject to customary approvals. ADC is raising capital; Dexus has not decided whether to participate, and further ADC funding requires approvals including its board. No operating capacity is confirmed; the media-reported roughly 2.16 GW plan is excluded from confirmed capacity.

At 5:18 p.m. ET on September 18, CleanSpark announced pricing of CSDC Finance I’s $2.276 billion of 7.875% senior secured notes due 2031 at 98.5% of principal. Proceeds are intended for remaining Sandersville construction costs, reimbursement of prior investments and reserves. Closing is expected September 25, subject to customary conditions. This supersedes the proposed $2.227 billion offering; it is not confirmation of received proceeds or operating capacity.

AIB announced the acquisition of about 29.4 acres in Texas. The added 55 MW comprises 15 MW energized and 40 MW contracted but under development, taking portfolio contracted power from 65 MW to 120 MW. The 120 MW is a portfolio contract figure, not energized power at this parcel or operating data-center capacity.

sources.claimScope: Loongson’s September 9 filing says CITIC Securities appointed Lin Kai to replace He Yang as a continuing-supervision sponsor representative, alongside Chen Xiying, following a change in He’s duties. The personnel change is not a CPU product or shipment milestone.

Micron's investor release says it demonstrated the world's first 512GB DDR5 RDIMM at up to about 9,200 MT/s, validating with AMD and Intel platforms, with volume production expected in the second half of 2027. Demo and validation are not current shipment volume.

Dell's SEC 8-K / Ex.99.1 reports record AI-optimized server orders, revenue and backlog, and raises FY27 AI-server and total-revenue guidance. Figures are company-reported and do not prove synchronized delivery across the full supply chain.

Ciena reported approximately $1.67 billion in FY2026 third-quarter revenue and guided fourth-quarter revenue to $1.75 billion, plus or minus $50 million. Management highlighted AI-related network demand; guidance is forward-looking, not realized revenue.
Coherent said it expanded its pluggable optical line systems portfolio with full C-band amplification for AI datacenter networks. A product launch is not proof of scaled deployment.
SK hynix's English newsroom says it presented HBF, PIM and SALT-KV AI-infrastructure concepts at AI Infra Summit 2026. Showcases are not current HBM shipment commitments.
Samsung Semiconductor's newsroom published a video on the architectural path from HBM to zHBM. It is technical communications, not a capacity or customer-order announcement.
HPE's SEC 8-K reports about $12.2B of Q3 revenue with strong Cloud & AI and server growth, a record order backlog, and raised outlook. Record backlog does not mean near-term full delivery.
